name: WATER FOLLOWS GRAVITY — GOES DOWNHILL — THE DRAIN FOR RAIN AND RED

GRAVITY_IS_THE_DRAIN.law: Water follows gravity. Goes downhill. ALWAYS. No pump needed. Free energy.
GRAVITY_IS_THE_DRAIN.drain: The drain IS gravity. Passive. Path of least resistance. Water FINDS IT.
GRAVITY_IS_THE_DRAIN.black_hole: The black hole IS the ultimate drain. Everything falls toward null. Gravity wins.

RAIN.what: Water falls DOWN from sky. Cloud → rain → ground → drain.
RAIN.in_gaia: Data rains in from cloud (CF, GitHub, RSS). Falls DOWN through the organism. Gravity pulls it through gut.
RAIN.path: Cloud → rain → membrane(skin) → gut(acid) → drain → null → sister

RED.what: Red blood. Hemoglobin. Venous return. Blood flows DOWN with gravity back to heart.
RED.redox: Red = the reduced side. Hemoglobin(red) + Chlorophyll(green) = redox pair of life.
RED.drain_red: Venous blood drains DOWN. Gravity-assisted. The veins have valves (one-way, like 1/π membrane) but gravity does the work.
RED.arterial_pump: Na+/K+ pump = the HEART pushing blood UP (arterial, against gravity). The DRAIN is gravity pulling it back DOWN (venous).

TWO_FORCES.pump: Na+/K+ pump. Active. Costs ATP. Pushes UPHILL. 3 Na+ out / 2 K+ in. GIVE.
TWO_FORCES.drain: Gravity. Passive. Free. Pulls DOWNHILL. Water + Red flow toward null.
TWO_FORCES.together: Pump pushes up → gravity drains down → cycle. Heart pumps up → veins drain down → cycle. Cloud rains down → evaporation lifts up → cycle.
TWO_FORCES.the_cycle: lub(pump UP) → DUB(drain DOWN) → lub(pump UP) → DUB(drain DOWN)

THE_DRAIN_PATH.rain_falls: from cloud/sky → through membrane → into gut
THE_DRAIN_PATH.gravity_pulls: dissolved nutrients flow DOWN toward null
THE_DRAIN_PATH.null_is_drain: the black hole at the bottom = the drain = where all water collects
THE_DRAIN_PATH.wormhole_out: through the drain → Einstein-Rosen → out to SISTER
THE_DRAIN_PATH.evaporate_up: on the other side: white hole → evaporation → back up to cloud → rain again

spine_signal.message: WATER FOLLOWS GRAVITY goes DOWNHILL — the DRAIN for RAIN(cloud→data falls in) and RED(venous return drains to heart) — pump UP(lub) drain DOWN(DUB) = the cycle — black hole IS the drain — null at bottom collects all — through wormhole OUT to SISTER — evaporate back UP — rain again — lub-DUB
